# Orca plugin catalog reference

<!-- Generated by `pnpm generate:plugin-schemas` from src/shared/plugins. Do not edit. -->

The orca-catalog.json file that lists installable plugins and their releases.

Add `"$schema": "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stablyai/orca/main/docs/schemas/plugins/orca-catalog.v2.schema.json"` to `orca-catalog.json` for completion and inline errors in your editor.
`Since` is the first Orca release that reads the field. Older releases ignore fields they do not know.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$schema` | string | no | 1.4.240 | JSON Schema URL for editor completion. Ignored by Orca. |
| `catalogVersion` | `2` | yes | 1.4.240 | Catalog format. Raised only for a change older Orca cannot ignore; a newer Orca reads this one. |
| `name` | string | yes | 1.4.240 | Marketplace display name. Example: `"Orca Plugins"` |
| `owner` | string | yes | 1.4.240 | Account that publishes the marketplace. Example: `"stablyai"` |
| `plugins` | [CatalogEntry](#catalogentry)[] | yes | 1.4.240 | Listed plugins, at most 2048. Each `id` should appear once; Orca keeps the first. An entry this Orca cannot read is skipped, never fatal. |

## CatalogEntry

One installable plugin.

| Field | Type | Required | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | 1.4.240 | `<publisher>.<id>`, matching the plugin's manifest. Each half is at most 64 characters, and the reserved names `constructor` and `prototype` are refused. Example: `"acme.gleam-syntax"` |
| `source` | [CatalogGitSource](#cataloggitsource) | yes |  | Where the plugin source lives. |
| `description` | string | no | 1.4.240 | Listing text shown in the catalog. |
| `categories` | string[] | no | 1.4.240 | Lowercase slugs used to filter the catalog, each listed once. At most 16; extras are ignored. |
| `releases` | [CatalogRelease](#catalogrelease)[] | yes | 1.4.240 | Installable releases, newest first. Orca installs the first one whose `minimumOrca` it meets, so keep older releases listed when you raise `engines.orca`. At most 32. |

## CatalogGitSource

Where the plugin source lives.

| Field | Type | Required | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `"git"` | yes | 1.4.240 | Source kind. Only `git` is supported. |
| `url` | string | yes | 1.4.240 | HTTPS or SSH URL of the plugin repository. Example: `"https://github.com/acme/orca-gleam-syntax.git"` |
| `ref` | string | yes | 1.4.240 | Branch or tag the author publishes from. Each release pins an exact commit. Example: `"main"` |

## CatalogRelease

The exact release the catalog vouches for. Orca refuses bytes that differ.

| Field | Type | Required | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | string | yes | 1.4.240 | The manifest's `version` for this release. Example: `"1.2.0"` |
| `commit` | string | yes | 1.4.240 | Full SHA-1 commit Orca checks out for this release. |
| `contentHash` | string | yes | 1.4.240 | SHA-256 of the plugin's installed files, as Orca computes it at install. |
| `execution` | `"data"` \| `"instructional"` \| `"sandboxed-ui"` \| `"trusted-worker"` | yes | 1.4.240 | The manifest's `execution` profile. Example: `"data"` |
| `minimumOrca` | string | yes | 1.4.240 | The manifest's `engines.orca` without `>=`. Older Orca lists the plugin but will not install it. Example: `"1.4.240"` |
| `types` | (`"interface-language"` \| `"app-theme"` \| `"terminal-theme"` \| `"icon-theme"` \| `"syntax"` \| `"instructions"` \| `"panel"` \| `"worker"`)[] | yes | 1.4.240 | Every kind of contribution the release carries, matching its manifest exactly. `instructions` needs the `instructional` profile or higher, `panel` needs `sandboxed-ui`, and `worker` needs `trusted-worker`. Example: `["syntax"]` |
| `name` | string | no | 1.4.240 | The manifest's `name`, so Orca can suggest the plugin before downloading it. Example: `"Gleam"` |
| `license` | string | no | 1.4.240 | SPDX license expression. Example: `"MIT"` |
| `repository` | string | no | 1.4.240 | Source repository page, https only. Example: `"https://github.com/acme/orca-gleam-syntax"` |
| `homepage` | string | no | 1.4.240 | Project homepage, https only. Example: `"https://example.com/gleam"` |
| `updatedAt` | string | no | 1.4.240 | When this release was published, as an ISO 8601 date or date-time. Example: `"2026-10-20"` |
| `changelog` | string | no | 1.4.240 | What changed in this release, as plain text. At most 2000 characters. Example: `"Adds highlighting for use expressions."` |
| `images` | [CatalogImages](#catalogimages) | no | 1.4.240 | Images extracted from the release by catalog CI, which re-encodes them and strips metadata. Same rules as the manifest: icon PNG, WEBP, static, at least 128×128, square, at most 256 KB. Cover PNG, JPEG, WEBP, static, at least 800×500, at most 1024 KB. Screenshots PNG, JPEG, WEBP, static, at least 1280×800, at most 1536 KB. Images must not imitate Orca's trust badges. |
| `themePreview` | [CatalogThemePreview](#catalogthemepreview)[] | no | 1.4.240 | Up to 4 theme palettes for listing art. Display only; the installed theme files decide the real colors. |
| `contributes` | [CatalogContribution](#catalogcontribution)[] | no | 1.4.240 | What the release adds, as the listing shows it. Generate it with the catalog tooling; Orca refuses an install whose manifest says otherwise. |
| `capabilities` | (`"workspace:read"` \| `"terminal:send"` \| `"notifications:show"` \| `"storage"` \| `"secrets"` \| `"events:subscribe"` \| `"settings:own"`)[] | no | 1.4.240 | Every capability the release asks for. Orca refuses an install whose manifest asks for different ones. Example: `["notifications:show"]` |
| `fileTypes` | string[] | no | 1.4.240 | Extensions, without the dot, that this release opens. Orca suggests the plugin when such a file has no viewer. |

## CatalogImages

Images extracted from the release by catalog CI, which re-encodes them and strips metadata. Same rules as the manifest: icon PNG, WEBP, static, at least 128×128, square, at most 256 KB. Cover PNG, JPEG, WEBP, static, at least 800×500, at most 1024 KB. Screenshots PNG, JPEG, WEBP, static, at least 1280×800, at most 1536 KB. Images must not imitate Orca's trust badges.

| Field | Type | Required | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `icon` | [CatalogImage](#catalogimage) | no |  | An image stored in the catalog repository. |
| `cover` | [CatalogImage](#catalogimage) | no |  | An image stored in the catalog repository. |
| `screenshots` | [CatalogImage](#catalogimage)[] | no | 1.4.240 | Screenshots, at most 6. |

## CatalogImage

An image stored in the catalog repository.

| Field | Type | Required | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | yes | 1.4.240 | File in the catalog repository, relative to its root. Relative to the plugin root; `..` segments and Windows device names such as `CON` are refused. Example: `"assets/acme.gleam/cover.png"` |
| `alt` | string | yes | 1.4.240 | What the image shows, for screen readers. Required. Example: `"The Dusk theme on a terminal"` |
| `sha256` | string | yes | 1.4.240 | SHA-256 of the file's bytes; Orca refuses bytes that differ. |
| `width` | integer | yes | 1.4.240 | Width in pixels. Example: `1600` |
| `height` | integer | yes | 1.4.240 | Height in pixels. Example: `1000` |

| `kind` | `"panels"` \| `"commands"` \| `"events"` \| `"languagePacks"` \| `"keybindings"` \| `"vmRecipes"` \| `"agents"` \| `"themes"` \| `"terminalThemes"` \| `"iconThemes"` \| `"syntaxes"` | yes | 1.4.240 | Contribution point. Example: `"themes"` |

## Versions and compatibility

- **What only lists is tolerant.** A catalog never decides what runs (installing re-checks the exact bytes), so Orca keeps whatever it can read: unknown keys are ignored at every level, an entry it cannot read is skipped, an invalid display-only field is dropped, a list over its limit is trimmed, and a repeated `id` keeps the first entry. Validation in CI is where these become errors.
- **The file name never changes.** `catalogVersion` (now 2) rises only for a change older clients cannot ignore; an Orca that sees a higher number refuses the catalog with "update Orca to browse this catalog" rather than misreading it.
- **Releases are a list, newest first.** Orca offers the first release whose `minimumOrca` it meets, so keep the previous release listed when a new one raises `engines.orca`; Orca shows "Needs Orca X" only when none fits.

## Clients before format 2

Orca reads `orca-catalog.json` first and falls back to `orca-marketplace.json`. That older file is frozen: shipped clients reject any key they do not know, so it carries only `name`, `owner` and each plugin's `id`, `source`, `description` and `categories`. Generate it from `orca-catalog.json` rather than editing two files:

```sh
node config/scripts/export-legacy-plugin-catalog.mjs orca-catalog.json orca-marketplace.json
```
